name: Rajendra Prasad Sharma
comment: The Shivansh Maharaja Special Royal Thali is unmatched in Sikar! Dal Makhani and Paneer Butter Masala served with pure desi ghee rotis. Superb hospitality and clean AC rooms.

name: Vikram Singh Rathore
comment: Ordered food to my room directly from the website. Handi Dum Biryani and hot Paneer Tikka arrived in 20 minutes flat. Zero room delivery charges made it even better!

name: Meenakshi Shekhawat
comment: Booked the AC dining hall for our anniversary dinner. Authentic Rajasthani Dal Baati Churma was fresh, rich, and mouth-watering. 100% pure veg hygiene.

name: Amit Singhal
comment: Best stay and dining hotel near Sikar station. Spacious Deluxe AC room, high-speed WiFi, and 24x7 quick room service. The mobile food ordering experience is top-notch.
